design_notes: Bright, modern dashboard aesthetic with white background and indigo/teal gradient accents. Rounded 12px cards with soft drop shadows. Sans-serif typography with bold headers and regular body text. Grid layout featuring 3 cards per row when possible. Colorful banner strip at top summarizing total volume and top district. Visual elements include: KPI tiles with spike indicators, heatmaps, donut charts, tag/chip lists, bar charts, stacked bars, multi-line charts, and leaderboard tables.
